content: Hey you! Just had to message before bed. I can't stop thinking about our last conversation. You always make my day brighter.
Aww, that's so sweet. I look forward to your messages too, especially since I don't really have anyone else to talk to here.
I know it's tough being away from home. I really admire how independent you are. If I was there, I'd take you out for coffee and show you around!
That sounds amazing. I wish I had someone like you close by. Grad school is pretty lonely sometimes.

You deserve someone who understands and supports you. I want to be that person for you, even from a distance. Can I tell you a secret? I just started a new job, and it's exciting but also a bit stressful.
Congratulations! What kind of job is it? I hope they're treating you well.

Thank you! It's financial consulting at a start-up. The team is great, but I miscalculated, my first paycheck isn't until the end of next month. Honestly, I'm a bit embarrassed to bring this up, but I'm in a tight spot with rent and food right now.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Are you going to be okay?

I'm trying not to freak out. I wouldn't normally ask, but since we've gotten so close, I wondered if you could help me out with a small loan. Just enough to make it until I get paid. I promise I'll pay you back, I swear on my honor.
I want to help, but I'm on a pretty tight budget myself. How much do you need?
I totally understand, and I hate asking. Even $100 would be a lifesaver right now. I trust you, and I hope you trust me too. I wouldn't ask if it wasn't important.
Okay, I can probably manage that. How should I send it to you?
Thank you so much, seriously. Do you have Cash App or Bitcoin? If it's easier, you could also get an Amazon or Steam gift card and send me the codes.
I've never used Bitcoin before. I could get a gift card at the store, though. Is that okay?
That's perfect! Just get a $100 Amazon or Steam gift card, scratch off the back, and send me the code here. You're honestly amazing, I can't thank you enough.
Alright, I'll go after my class tomorrow. Just want to help however I can.
You're a true friend, and so much more. I promise I'll make this up to you. Maybe when I visit, dinner on me? You're really special to me.
That would be really nice. I haven't had anyone say that to me in a long time.
You deserve to be appreciated. I feel so lucky we've met. Let me know when you get the card, okay?
Sure, I'll message you as soon as I have it. Hope things get easier for you soon.
With your help, I know they will. You're honestly the best thing that's happened to me all month.
